items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: It was Red Buttons and Nancy Walker, and we went into "High Button Shoes."

ctx.x: "Mr. Wonderful" had came about so, from Barefoot Milton Boy With Cheek, with Rosenstock, that show didn't last too
long. It was Red Buttons and Nancy Walker, and we went into "High Button Shoes."
